t: POLICY: Commit and closeout per completed lug or significant milestone — progress over perfection
description: Every completed lug or significant milestone gets its own git commit immediately. Don't batch multiple completions into one commit. This ensures progress is always persisted and recoverable. Applies to all spokes, not just framework.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Commit cadence policy: one commit per lug completion or milestone. Drives visible progress and prevents loss.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not a replacement for closeout ceremony. Full /wai-closeout still runs at session end. This is about intermediate persistence.
